messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Smart-routing detected oscillation in fallback decisions for model-family 'rax-7' when serving quantized variants in eu-west-1. Symptoms: repeated region/variant switches causing 5xx bursts and elevated tail latency for affected customers. Pager: marta (oncall)

marta (oncall): acked. I'm on it. putting a short post to the channel.

marta (oncall): quick summary: traffic is flapping between rax-7-quantized (q4_0) and rax-7-fp16 due to compatibility checks failing intermittently. Looks like the compatibility matrix service is returning false negatives for tool-calling support on q4_0.

chris (eng-runtime): seeing the same in logs. KV cache misses spike when variant flips. sample log:
```
2026-01-18T08:12:34Z route-evaluator INFO route=smart-route id=req-8a1f compat_check=false -> fallback(region=eu-west-1, model=rax-7-fp16)
2026-01-18T08:12:34Z runtime INFO model-swap start req=req-8a1f
2026-01-18T08:12:34Z runtime WARN toolcall-mismatch: q4_0 unsupported-toolcall=true
```

kevin (eng-ml): quick note: we recently updated the model onboarding classifier thresholds for tool-calling detection. I pushed a rule that rejects q4_0 in some edgecases where auxiliary metadata is missing. Could be the regression.

lee (sre): customer impact?

support-sam: initial telemetry shows ~12 customer sessions had errors (invalid tool response) and ~1200 requests saw latency > 2s in the last 10m. No full outages but several timeouts bubbled to customers. A few high-traffic tenants in EU saw repeated retries.

marta (oncall): mitigation plan proposal: 1) disable smart-routing policy for rax-7 family in eu-west-1 (fail open to configured fallback model), 2) pin traffic to fp16 variant for affected customers while we patch the matrix service, 3) create canary rule to avoid mass rollout until fix validated. Anyone object?

chris (eng-runtime): +1 to disabling smart-routing for that model-family in the region. I can run the CLI change. Command to flip policy:
```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --model-family rax-7 --region eu-west-1 --policy static --static-model rax-7-fp16 --reason "incident 2187654321: disable smart-routing for quant-compat instability"
```

marta (oncall): do it and post the change id. I'll update pagerduty incident and notify CS.

chris (eng-runtime): executed. Change-id: change/20260118-0734. Observability: starting to see reduced flips. Rechecking tail latency.

ops-bot: change/20260118-0734 applied to 4 routing nodes in eu-west-1.

lee (sre): monitoring - latency tail downward trend but still some 5xx from older in-flight requests. Can we throttled retries on the client side or adjust gateway timeouts?

marta (oncall): initiated API gateway retry suppression for that tenant class (gold/plat excluded). Command:
```
redwoodctl gateway config set --region eu-west-1 --retry-policy "no-retry-on-compat-failure"
```

chris (eng-runtime): confirmed metrics: fallback loops dropped ~86% in 3m. Errors trending down.

kevin (eng-ml): for root cause: I'll roll back the classifier rule that rejects q4_0 when metadata is missing and add unit tests. Patch plan: update model-compat service to consult model manifest fallback heuristics before outright rejecting toolcall capability. Patch will be on a feature branch, then patch to prod service via canary.

kevin (eng-ml): patch PR: github.com/redwood/ml/compat-service/pull/487 - includes test vectors and a guard for older manifest shapes.

marta (oncall): handoff: chris/kevin continue working on runtime + compat-service fix. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate customer comms with support-sam. If anything regresses, page me.

support-sam: FYI sent initial heads-up to affected customers: "We observed transient inference errors and increased latency in EU. We've applied a targeted routing configuration to stabilize traffic. Engineers are working on a root-cause fix. Next update in 30m or earlier if we have significant changes."

chris (eng-runtime): deploying hotfix to routing-eval service as a precaution to ignore compatibility-service transient failures for q4_0 for 10m window. Deploy command:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/routing-eval-eu-west-1 --record
```

ops-bot: deployment/routing-eval-eu-west-1 rollout started (uid: rollout-0a9b).

kevin (eng-ml): canary tests: running test harness for tool-calls against q4_0 with older manifest samples. if green, we'll merge PR and promote.

marta (oncall): next update check in 20m. if stable at 30m we close incident and open follow-up for postmortem and matrix fixes. Adding tags: smart-routing, quant-compat, eu-west-1, paged.

chris (eng-runtime): metrics stable at T+12m: error-rate back to baseline, latency percentiles improving.

kevin (eng-ml): canary passed. PR merged and cherry-picked to prod. change-id: change/20260118-0815.

marta (oncall): rolling to monitor. preparing postmortem draft: root-cause = overly-strict compat classifier + lack of transient-tolerant fallback in routing-eval. Action items: 1) add regression tests for q4_0 toolcall metadata shapes, 2) make routing-eval tolerant to compat-service transient errors (circuit breaker), 3) run chaos test for model-variant flapping. owners assigned: kevin/chris/lee.

support-sam: Customer comms updated: included estimated affected sessions and mitigation. No escalations so far.

marta (oncall): closing active pager. If anyone sees residual anomalies reopen thread. Great teamwork. :thumbsup:
